 Within Pali literature, passage-level parallels are identified in the *Udāna* (Ud 4.7) and the Vinaya *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* (Pācittiya 22). In Sanskrit literature, parallel verses are found in Sarvāstivāda and Mūlasarvāstivāda *Bhikkhu Pātimokkha* fragments from Turfan and Gilgit, as well as the *Udānavarga* (*Apramādavarga*, UV 4 and UVS 4). Further parallels are preserved in the Tibetan *Udānavarga* (Uv Kg 4) and Chinese collections, including T 210.2, T 212.4, and T 212.5, with a resembling parallel in T 213.4.
